PZZ700-211015-
127 PM PST Fri Nov 20 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1024 mb high was 800 nautical miles west of San Diego 
and a 1012 mb low was over the northern Gulf of California. Winds 
and seas remain elevated in the outer waters through this 
afternoon and evening. Flow will turn offshore late tonight into 
Saturday. Weak onshore flow returns Sunday, increasing Sunday 
night, then decreasing for Monday and Tuesday. Winds and seas look
to increase again late Wednesday.

$$
